To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

new designs of recursive wideband digital differentiators and wideband digital integrators are proposed by optimizing a general recursive filter of fourth-order system over different Nyquist band and by inverting the designed recursive digital filters with suitable modifications.
we have designed a class of recursive digital differentiator with nearly linear phase over wideband and recursive digital integrator with nearly constant group delay over wideband.

we have developed the new recursive digital differentiators that have nearly linear phase response over wideband and have the choice of suitable design according to the importance and requirement of accuracy, bandwidth or simplicity of the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of recursive digital wideband differentiators and integrator with the following properties: 1) the recursive digital differentiators have nearly linear phase response over a wideband; 2) the recursive digital integrators have nearly linear phase over a wideband and also the phase responses of recursive digital integrator are opposite to the phase responses of corresponding recursive digital differentiator; and 3) the recursive digital filter can also be designed to have a desired pole-zero locations.
the design of new recursive digital differentiator with nearly linear phase response over wideband.
the design of recursive digital filters and their applications to the design of recursive wideband digital differentiators and digital integrators with nearly linear phase responses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed method is an efficient and simple method to design recursive wideband digital differentiators and also recursive wideband digital integrators with nearly linear phase responses and also provides the choice of suitable differentiator and integrators according to the importance and the system simplicity.
the designed recursive digital integrators and differentiators are very useful in the applications of digital signal processing.
a class of recursive digital differentiator is obtained by optimizing the general fourth-order recursive filters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our new recursive digital differentiator is more efficient and effective than the existing recursive digital differentiators in the sense that our new recursive differentiator is more accurate, more wideband, more simple and more efficient.
we have designed recursive digital differentiator/integrator systems with nearly linear phase responses in a wideband.
our designs are very useful for wideband signal processing, and the proposed zero-reflection approach can be used for the design of wideband digital filters with nearly linear phase responses.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the designed recursive digital integrators and differentiators are suitable for the applications where the accuracy, bandwidth and simplicity of the system is important.
the proposed recursive wideband digital differentiators and the integrators can be used in many applications where wideband digital differentiator and the integrator are needed.

the recursive digital differentiators can be designed by optimizing a fourth-order recursive digital filters over different Nyquist band and also the recursive digital integrators can be obtained by inverting transfer function of the designed recursive differentiator.
